verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents Agent Auth, a first-party feature for giving agents OAuth 2.0 credentials to access other systems. That is its own capability for issuing agent credentials, but the evidence never says those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. The pack also says nothing about scoped LangSmith API keys or service keys for agents. missing for 10: documented permission scopes or least-privilege controls on agent credentials, scoped or limited-permission LangSmith API keys for agents, credential lifecycle (rotation, expiry, revocation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
